title: Reval Rebel cutscene sequence (ADR 0034)
description: An authored cinematic sequence: an ordered shot list with captions, dialogue, camera motion and a chain to the next sequence or scene. Each shot carries a still (shipped tier) and a reserved video path (later tier) plus the prompts that produce them, so a tier upgrade adds files without rewriting the script.

chapter.description: Player-facing chapter heading shown once at the start of the sequence.

grade.description: Colour-grade family (ADR 0034 §3). Chapters are separated by grade, not by medium.

skippable.description: False only for a sequence whose facts cannot be recovered elsewhere. Default true.

chain_target.description: What runs when the sequence ends or is skipped.

motion.description: Slow camera move applied to the still, and the motion the video tier must reproduce.

line.description: One spoken or narrated line. `speaker` is the display name; `speaker_id` ties it to a character record for later voice casting.

voice.description: Optional res:// path to the spoken take of this line. When set, the player plays it on the Voice bus and holds the line until the audio ends.

delivery.description: Voice direction for the video tier: tone, pace, accent, breath.

conditions.description: Optional state conditions (same ops as dialogue). The line plays only when all hold; a player without game state drops conditional lines.

sound.description: Per-shot audio. `music` starts an underscore that keeps playing until the sequence ends (then fades out); `ambience` is reserved.

music.description: Optional res:// mp3/ogg underscore started with this shot. Empty keeps whatever is already playing.

music_volume_db.description: Music-bus level of the underscore in dB (default -16, well under the narrator).

authoring.description: Authoring-only block. The runtime ignores it; generation tools and the video tier read it. Keeping it in the record makes the prompt that produced a frame inseparable from the frame.

direction.description: What the shot has to accomplish and how it is framed.

image_prompt.description: Prompt used to generate the still. Grammar: cinematics/PROMPT_GRAMMAR.md.

video_prompt.description: Prompt for the later video tier: subject motion, camera motion, duration, dialogue and lip-sync notes.

video.description: Reserved for the video tier. Empty means the still is used.

hold_seconds.description: Minimum time the shot stays on screen when it has no lines.

caption.description: Place-and-date card, shown top-left. Carries the facts a skipping player must still get.
